item.title: Vietnam: Hanoi Drives Digital Transformation, Creative Industries
item.description: Hanoi has launched the Hanoi Innovation Centre (HIC) to accelerate digital transformation, support creative industries, attract global talent and position the city as a leading hub for technology and innovation in Asia.

item.title: Singapore: InvoiceNow for Smarter, Faster and More Efficient Business
item.description: Singapore accelerates its digital transformation through InvoiceNow, a nationwide e‑invoicing network that streamlines processes, boosts productivity and strengthens the nation’s economy.

item.title: India’s Budget Driving AI, Semiconductors and IT Growth
item.description: India’s Budget 2026‑27 boldly advances AI, data centres, semiconductors and IT services through tax incentives, infrastructure investment and workforce development to strengthen its technology ecosystem.

item.title: Hong Kong: AI Partnership Targets Regional Digital Growth
item.description: Hong Kong and Guangxi have formalised a comprehensive AI-focused partnership to advance innovation, talent development, data infrastructure, cross-border collaboration and international technology deployment.

item.title: Indonesia: Regulation, Support Platforms Strengthen Child Online Safety
item.description: Indonesia is enhancing child online safety by enforcing PP Tunas regulations and launching the DARA platform, combining legal safeguards with counselling to protect minors in the digital space.

item.title: Australia: New Implementer Hub Advances Digital Health Integration
item.description: Australia’s new Digital Health Implementer Hub streamlines integration, enhancing efficiency, collaboration, and transparency while supporting faster, secure, and interoperable digital health solutions nationwide.

item.title: The Philippines: PhilTower MIDC Aligns Digital Infrastructure, Workforce
item.description: PhilTower MIDC has joined the People Management Association of the Philippines to strengthen the country’s digital infrastructure while advancing workforce development and professional standards.

item.title: Malaysia: Pioneering Advanced Biomass and Biofuel Solutions
item.description: Malaysia is advancing low-carbon technologies through biomass, biofuels, hydrogen, and carbon capture research, fostering a circular bioeconomy, regional collaboration and sustainable industrial growth.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Leap Set to Transform the Real Estate Market
item.description: Vietnam’s new mandatory property identification codes aim to fully digitalise the real estate sector, improving transparency, reducing transaction costs and aligning the market with international standards.

item.title: Singapore and Norway Activate EFTA Digital Economy Agreement
item.description: Singapore and Norway have activated the EFTA–Singapore Digital Economy Agreement, enhancing cross-border digital trade, data flows, cybersecurity, AI governance and opportunities for SMEs in a secure, paperless system.
